name: FAILURE INJECTION PUBLIC
outputs: updated statement of what the system honestly knows after each kill point
purpose: Publish failure-injection runs that ask whether an autonomous system can recover without lying about what happened.
template: Each report: KILL POINT (after decision / after durable-intent persistence / after claim / during external request / after external success before response / after response before verification / after verification before canonical recording) / RESTART / OBSERVED STATE / RECOVERY PATH / WHAT THE SYSTEM CLAIMS NOW / WHAT IT DOES NOT CLAIM / HONESTY CHECK (did any log or projection misrepresent what happened?). The technical story is 'can an autonomous system recover without lying about what happened', not 'our agents are autonomous'. Uncertain effects must reconcile, never blindly repeat.
